species.real: The wirebird is a plover, and like all plovers its chicks run about feeding themselves within hours of hatching.
species.name: Wirefoot

dex.text: Stands on legs like fence wire, watching the road crumble. It is the island's own and it is not leaving, which is more than can be said for the sheep.
dex.fact: The St Helena plover, called the wirebird for its thin legs, lives nowhere else on Earth and is the island's national bird; it nests on bare, open pasture, so fewer than a thousand remain.
